name: Brick Type Selection
aliases: Hybrid Bricking with Elemental Brick Types
definition: A strategy to select the optimal data structure representation (dense, empty, octree, voxel list) for each brick by balancing performance (run time) and memory consumption.
summary: Brick Type Selection constructs memory-efficient volumes by assigning optimal representations to bricks based on local sparsity, unlike conventional bricking that only distinguishes empty from non-empty regions.
